title: The Cicones
setup: Your first stop after Troy is Ismarus, the city of the Cicones peoples. Your crew sacked the city and divied up the treasure, and you are told to leave right away. Yet, when you look around, there's still wine to drink and sheep and cattle to eat.

title: The Lotus-Eaters
imageCredit: Painting of the Lotus-Eaters signed NB
setup: After 9 days blown off course by storms, your ship reaches the land of the Lotus-Eaters. The people are friendly, and they offer you the lotus flower to eat. Eating it makes you feel a sweet, peaceful Euphoria. Yet, with each bite you feel your image of home slipping.

choices.text: Stop eating the lotus and keep sailing
Eat the lotus and feel happiness forever

title: Polyphemus
setup: You landed on the Island of the Cyclops, and got trapped in his cave. You escaped by blinding the Cyclops Polyphemus and hiding your men under his sheep. He still thinks your name is Nobody. Now your ship is pulling away from the shore, and he is raging at you on the cliffs.

choices.text: Shout your real name at Polyphemus

title: Scylla and Charybdis
setup: Your ship must pass through a narrow strait between the sea monster Scylla and the whirlpool Charybdis. Scylla could grab your men and eat them, while the whirlpool could swallow the whole ship. The goddess Circe told you to steer close to Scylla and accept the guaranteed loss of 6 men. However, you could face Charybdis and try to fight it off, potentially saving them all.

title: The Cattle of Helios
setup: Your ship is stranded on Thrinacia, the island where the sun god Helios keeps his cattle. The winds have you trapped here for a month and the food is dwindling. Circe and Tiresias have both warned you that eating the cattle will curse you and your crew.

choices.text: Respect the gods and potentially starve
Eat the cattle to survive, but break your oath

title: Calypso's Offer
setup: You have shipwreck and washed up on the island of the goddess Calypso. You've lost count of time but you have been there for 7 years. The gods have ordered her to let you go home, but she tells you that if you stay with her, she will make you immortal and ageless.

title: Return to Ithaca
setup: You are home at last after 20 years. Athena has disguised you as an old beggar, and the suitors who want to marry your wife are feasting in your hall. When you ask them for food, the suitor Antinous insults you and throws stuff at you.

choices.text: Endure it and keep your disguise
